primary.target: open(D) to close(D+4), raw asset return minus SPY same window
primary.hypothesis: hit rate > 0.50 and Brier < causal prequential climatology

decision_rule.look: one confirmatory look at first weekly close after minimum sample; interim looks exploratory
decision_rule.hit_test: one-sided weekly-block bootstrap lower 95% confidence bound > 0.50
decision_rule.brier_test: weekly-block bootstrap upper 95% confidence bound of paired Brier minus prequential climatology < 0
decision_rule.resampling: 10000 draws, seed 20261006; preserve asset cross-section and overlapping horizons by resampling whole calendar weeks
decision_rule.multiplicity: primary intersection rule; all other variants exploratory; count every attempted variant; no alpha claim from secondary looks

exclusions: protected products/windows (including price warmup and label endpoint)
unavailable target prices remain pending; never impute

labels.equity_5d: open(D) to close(D+4) using pinned XNYS sessions
labels.equity_primary: asset raw return minus SPY raw return
labels.crypto: 13:30Z(D) to 13:30Z(D+1 or D+5); exact Coinbase one-minute candle open, available after candle arrives
labels.ties: return > 0 is UP, zero is not UP; report tie counts
labels.pending: future labels append separately, immutable original PredictionRecord

portfolio.directional_probability: UP uses p_outperform; DOWN uses 1-p_outperform; require directional probability >= 0.55
portfolio.weights: signed p_outperform - 0.50, proportional with 10% name cap and <=100% gross
portfolio.consensus: both reviewed analysts agree; use probability closest to 0.50; disagreements abstain
portfolio.cohorts: 1d and 5d are separate portfolios; allocate 1/5 capital to each 5d daily cohort; SPY hedge also obeys gross and 10% cap
portfolio.spread: fixed preregistered paper assumption, not observed bid/ask; modeled net P&L

climatology: past already observed consensus asset/horizon/population outcomes at decision time; initial 0.50; no future fitted probability
revision_note: Revision 4 (2026-10-07), before any paper order: retains revision 3 catch-up repair and registers separate Alpaca execution variants with their frozen execution spec. Primary shadow hypothesis, labels and portfolio stay revision 2 rules.

degraded_continuation.run_status: DEGRADED (not COMPLETE) when exactly one analyst yields no valid output after its retries
triggers: any invalid-output code of that analyst
never_degrades: BUDGET_EXHAUSTED (except an exhausted analyst role during an authorized catch-up; aggregate/reviewer budget failures still fail)
degraded_continuation.missing_analyst: its views and its reviewed twin are recorded as verdict MISSING with the error code; never predicted, labelled or scored
degraded_continuation.consensus: ABSTAIN for every asset and horizon that day (needs both analysts); counts as abstention, no position
degraded_continuation.scores: the present analyst, its reviewed twin and the reviewer verdicts are scored exactly as in a COMPLETE run
degraded_continuation.primary_sample: a DEGRADED day contributes only abstained consensus asset-days to the primary variant; it never adds non-abstained primary samples
degraded_continuation.reviewer: sees only the analyst output that exists

catchup.operator_approval: 2026-10-07 ~12:45Z: "on peut pas reprendre le run mtn on perd trop"; extends the 2026-10-06 same-day recovery rule after a FAILED daily run even when models were called
refusals: daily run COMPLETE or DEGRADED, even if a later refused attempt is FAILED
insufficient aggregate budget for remaining analysts plus reviewer
decision at or after session close minus 80 minutes
catchup.budgets: same durable per-role calls_per_day + retries_per_day and max_llm_calls_per_day bank; failed calls are never refunded; catchup_run is capped at one per day
catchup.missing_analyst: an exhausted analyst is not dispatched; its views and reviewed twin are MISSING with BUDGET_EXHAUSTED; run DEGRADED, reviewer sees only present outputs, consensus ABSTAIN; MISSING is never predicted, labelled or scored
catchup.decision: must finish before session close minus 80 minutes; orchestration and runner deadlines enforce this margin
catchup.population: authorized unprotected equities and ETFs only; no crypto
catchup.scores: all catch-up groups, baselines and cohorts are separate; never pooled into the primary variant or its minimum sample
